name_zh: 107 年兒童及少年生活狀況調查檔-12至未滿18歲少年
name_en: Children and Youth Living Conditions Survey 2018
data_description_zh:
1. 調查目的：蒐集 12至未滿18歲少年之生活與健康狀況、托育與教養問題、對
福利措施之需求、利用與期許等資料。
2. 調查項目：少年基本資料、少年生活狀況、對於少年福利措施的需求和使用情
形、未來期許。
3. 調查區域範圍：以臺閩地區為調查區域範圍。
4. 調查對象：居住於調查區域範圍內之 12至未滿18歲之在校學生。
5. 調查方法：由訪員至樣本學校，採教室內由學生自填訪問表方式，訪問員逐一
唸題目，學生逐一作答。
6. 抽樣方法：
(1)國中少年：採三段分層隨機抽樣法。將全國按六都、北、中、南、東及金馬地
區等分為 11個副母體，第一段抽樣單位為學校，以PPS 系統抽樣，抽出樣本
學校，各層內學校按國中學生數多寡進行排序，以累計國中學生數進行系統隨
機抽樣抽出樣本學校；第二段抽樣單位為班級，樣本學校內，各年級各隨機抽
出1個班級；第三段抽樣單位為學生，樣本班級內，將學生依學號排序，以系
統隨機抽樣方法分別抽出 6位學生做為本次訪問對象。
(2)高中(職)及五專前3 年少年：採分層三段隨機抽樣法。將全國按六都、北、中、
南、東及金馬地區等分為 11 個副母體，第一段抽樣單位為學校，以PPS 系統
抽樣，抽出樣本學校，各層內學校先按市區、鎮、鄉排序，再按(高中、高職、
五專前三年)學生數多寡進行排序，以累計(高中、高職、五專前三年)學生數進
行系統隨機抽樣抽出樣本學校；第二段抽樣單位為班級，樣本學校內，各年級
各隨機抽出 1個班級；第三段抽樣單位為學生，樣本班級內，將學生依學號排
序，以系統隨機抽樣方法分別抽出 9位學生做為本次訪問對象。
notes_zh:
1. 本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身
分證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院
日期等欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，
並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定
當事人。
2. 各年度問卷題目和內容，以及所勾選之項目不盡相同，需比對各年度調查問卷。
3. 中文欄位名稱與資料檔欄位標籤不盡相同，僅供參考，請以英文欄位名稱為主。

data_description_en:
1. Survey purpose: To collect data on the living and health conditions of adolescents aged 12 to under 18, childcare and rearing issues,
needs for welfare measures, and their use of and expectations for them.
2. Survey items: Basic adolescent data, adolescent living conditions, needs for and use of adolescent welfare measures,
future expectations.
3. Survey area: Taiwan-Fujian area.
4. Survey subjects: Enrolled students aged 12 to under 18 residing in the survey area.
5. Survey method: Interviewers go to the sample schools; students self-complete the questionnaire in the classroom while the interviewer
reads out the questions one by one and students answer one by one.
6. Sampling method:
(1) Junior high school adolescents: Three-stage stratified random sampling. The country is divided into 11 sub-populations by the six special municipalities, North, Central, South, East, and Kinmen-Matsu
regions; the first-stage sampling unit is the school, selected by PPS systematic sampling to draw sample
schools; within each stratum, schools are sorted by number of junior high school students, and sample schools are drawn by systematic
random sampling on cumulative junior high school student counts; the second-stage sampling unit is the class; within each sample school, one class is randomly drawn from each
grade; the third-stage sampling unit is the student; within each sample class, students are sorted by student ID number and 6 students are drawn by
systematic random sampling as survey subjects.
(2) Senior high school (vocational) and first 3 years of five-year junior college adolescents: Stratified three-stage random sampling. The country is divided into 11 sub-populations by the six special municipalities, North, Central,
South, East, and Kinmen-Matsu regions; the first-stage sampling unit is the school, selected by PPS systematic
sampling to draw sample schools; within each stratum, schools are first sorted by urban area, town, township,
then sorted by number of students (senior high, vocational high, first three years of five-year junior college),
and sample schools are drawn by systematic random sampling on cumulative student counts (senior high, vocational high, first three years of five-year junior college); the second-stage sampling unit is the class; within each sample school, one class is randomly drawn from each
grade; the third-stage sampling unit is the student; within each sample class, students are sorted by student ID number and 9 students are drawn by
systematic random sampling as survey subjects.
